title_en: All of Earth's Water in One Ball Is Tiny #Shorts
desc_en:
If all of Earth's water were gathered into one ball, it would be about 1,385 km across. Liquid fresh water: about 272.8 km. Lakes and rivers, where most of our everyday water comes from: about 56.2 km.

Source: USGS Water Science School, How Much Water is There on Earth?
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science #scale
desc_ko:
지구의 물을 전부 공 하나로 모으면 지름 약 1,385km. 액체 상태 민물은 약 272.8km, 우리가 매일 쓰는 물이 주로 오는 호수와 강의 물은 약 56.2km입니다.

출처: 미국 지질조사국(USGS) Water Science School
